logo.description: Official horizontal burgundy banner with the Iditarod National Historic Trail badge, Alliance name, and circular tripod emblem.
logo.rights: Official Alliance identity asset; not licensed as public domain or Creative Commons. Preserve the mark and use only to identify the Alliance in this proposed website.

notes: Public links are research references only; no payment, store, or mailing-list integration was configured.
The official newsletter page describes The Tripod as the IHTA member newsletter and provides PDF issues; a standalone public email signup destination was not found.
The official store is served on the existing Weebly site.
The /donate.html and /membership.html paths return 404 and should not be used.

The existing /images/summer.webp source (https://www.flickr.com/photos/alaska_region/29533359703/) describes Meares Glacier and Unakwik Inlet in Prince William Sound; do not caption it as a specific Iditarod Trail section.
